name: DiligenceOS
description: The due-diligence agent you call before a transaction, hire or contract: one verdict with a signed receipt and a signed log anyone can check against a pinned key. Pre-alpha: a proof of concept, not to be relied on for real decisions.

roles.name: diligence
roles.purpose: Returns PROCEED, HOLD or RED_FLAG for a subject and a transaction, from the data its operator has loaded. Sanctions and document findings quote their source so a reader can re-check them; identity and track-record findings do not yet. Every verdict is a signed receipt in an append-only signed log.
roles.measure: Receipts logged that were never revoked and never contradicted an earlier verdict on the same inputs, as a share of receipts logged

roles.name: witness
roles.purpose: Verifies another party's signed log against a key the caller pinned and signs a receipt about what it checked. It witnesses integrity and contents; it never approves or authorizes a spend, and holds no spending authority.
roles.measure: Plane logs submitted for witnessing that verified end to end and were signed, as a share of logs submitted
